studio.name: Stafbyte
studio.about: Stafbyte is an independent game studio from Australia. We make colourful, easy-to-pick-up games for your phone: pixel-art puzzles, cartoon tycoons and whatever we think of next.

games.name: Pixel Sudoku
games.blurb: Fill the grid, add up the cages, collect cards and postcards. Daily puzzles, events and four difficulties.
games.description: Pixel Sudoku is a cosy pixel-art take on Killer Sudoku. Fill the grid so every row, column and 3x3 box holds 1 to 9, and every dashed cage adds up to the small number in its corner. No digit repeats inside a cage.
features: Easy, Medium, Hard and Expert puzzles, all with a single solution.
A new puzzle every day, with a calendar and gold stars.
Sudoku Adventure, First Try Challenge, Creative Studio, Forest World and Cage Rush.
Win a game to get a card. Six themes and five rarities, from Common to Legendary.
Finish Forest World levels to reveal postcards and collect stamps.
Notes, undo, hints, light and dark mode. Works offline.
games.note: Free to play with ads. Remove them any time with a one-time purchase.

games.name: Street Kings: Idle Tycoon
games.tagline: From the corner to the crown
games.blurb: A cartoon idle tycoon. Build your block, hire your crew and keep the cash rolling in, even while you are away.
